slides.title: Cover
slides.transcript: [warmly] The Black and White Zoo. <break time="0.4s" /> A book for Yusuf. Nine bold animals to look at together. Are you ready, Yusuf? <break time="0.5s" /> [warmly] Let's turn the page.

slides.title: Zebra
slides.transcript: [warmly] Zebra. <break time="0.4s" /> Black stripe, white stripe, all in a row. Clip clop! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Clip clop!

slides.title: Panda
slides.transcript: [warmly] Panda. <break time="0.4s" /> A round white face, with two black ears. Munch! Munch! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Mmmm, munch!

slides.title: Cow
slides.transcript: [warmly] Cow. <break time="0.4s" /> Big white cow, with big black spots. Moooooo! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Moooooooooo!

slides.title: Penguin
slides.transcript: [warmly] Penguin. <break time="0.4s" /> A little black coat, and a soft white tummy. Waddle, waddle, waddle... <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Splash!

slides.title: Owl
slides.transcript: [warmly] Owl. <break time="0.4s" /> Two big eyes, wide awake in the dark. Hoooooo! <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Hoooooo!

slides.title: Orca
slides.transcript: [warmly] Orca. <break time="0.4s" /> Black on top, white underneath, up and over the waves. Whoooooosh! <break time="0.5s" /> [excited] Sploooosh!

slides.title: Sheep
slides.transcript: [warmly] Sheep. <break time="0.4s" /> A little white cloud, with four little legs. Baaaaaa! <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Baaaaaa!

slides.title: Puppy
slides.transcript: [warmly] Puppy. <break time="0.4s" /> Spots on his back, spots on his nose. Woof! Woof woof! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Woof!

slides.title: Cat
slides.transcript: [warmly] Cat. <break time="0.4s" /> A black cat with four white paws, and long white whiskers. Meow! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Meow!

slides.title: Goodnight
slides.transcript: [warmly] Goodnight. <break time="0.4s" /> Goodnight zebra, goodnight panda, goodnight owl in the tree. Goodnight, Yusuf. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Sleep well, little one.
